triples.tail_surface: all of the liquid bypassing through a pump mounted internal type relief valve
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 全部液体通过泵装内置安全阀旁通
triples.evidence_text: DON’T operate the pump with all of the liquid bypassing through a pump mounted internal type relief valve, or without any flow of liquid going through the pump for more than a couple of minutes. Operation under either of these conditions may result in a heat build-up in the pump, which could cause hazardous conditions or happenings.

triples.tail_surface: provide a pressure relief valve for the discharge side of the pump

triples.tail_surface: speeds faster than shown in the catalog for your model

triples.evidence_text: DON’T run pump at speeds faster than shown in the catalog for your model.

triples.tail_surface: pressures higher than those shown in the catalog for your model
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 超过型号目录所示压力
triples.evidence_text: DON’T require pump to develop pressures higher than those shown in the catalog for your model.

triples.tail_surface: vented through the suction or discharge lines or other openings provided for this purpose
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 通过吸入或排出管线或其他专用开口泄放
triples.evidence_text: DO make sure any pump that has residual system pressure in it, or that has handled high vapor pressure liquids, such as LP-gas, ammonia, Freons, etc., has been vented through the suction or discharge lines or other openings provided for this purpose.

triples.tail_surface: drained, flushed, vented and/or cooled before it is disassembled
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拆卸前排空、冲洗、泄放和/或冷却
triples.evidence_text: DO make sure any pump that has handled a corrosive, flammable, hot, or toxic liquid has been drained, flushed, vented and/or cooled before it is disassembled.
